ruleDefinitions.name: Office Macro File Creation From Suspicious Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a office macro file from a a suspicious process

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$"))) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.docm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dotm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlsm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xltm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.potm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.pptm$")))
